## Bitaxe Project
- ESP-Miner Repository: [https://github.com/bitaxeorg/ESP-Miner](https://github.com/bitaxeorg/ESP-Miner)
- Website: [https://bitaxe.org/](https://bitaxe.org/)
- License: GPL-3.0
- Description: Bitaxe is an open-source Bitcoin ASIC miner for the ESP32. The ESP-Miner firmware powers Bitaxe hardware devices.

## Socket.IO (v4.7.4)
- Source: [socket.io](https://socket.io/)
- Repository: [GitHub](https://github.com/socketio/socket.io)
- License: MIT
- Description: Socket.IO enables real-time, bidirectional and event-based communication between the browser and the server.
